author: TREY the Explainer
description:
Taking care of your health just got easier, thanks to my sponsor Zocdoc — start here at: https://zocdoc.com/treytheexplainer

A second installment in my new series "Ancient Cribs" - a series in which I recreate the real houses of famous historical figures based on their archaeological ruins! In this video, I examine the mysterious "Structure 1" beneath the Sisters of Nazareth Convent in the modern city of Nazareth, a building that has been claimed to be the childhood home of Jesus Christ. I hope you enjoy!
